content: The camel carried all the heavy sacks of sugar, but the horse pranced ahead and received all the applause.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: In human organizations, flashy showmen often strut on stage to claim public credit, while the quiet, exhausted workers who bore the crushing burden through the desert night are forgotten in the shadows. Do not despair; heaven sees the camel's sweet burden.
practicalInsight: Go out of your way today to thank the unseen, quiet contributors in your workplace whose work carries the caravan.
reflectionPrompt: Are you toiling faithfully like the camel, feeling bitter because flashy horses are stealing the applause?
